items.a: Yes. Moneylytics does not store any banking credentials or login information. You only import exported bank statements as CSV or CAMT files — the app never has direct access to your bank account.

items.q: How does the import work exactly?
items.a: Export your bank statement from your banking app or online banking portal as a CSV or CAMT.053 file. Upload it to Moneylytics. The system automatically detects duplicates, so you can import multiple times without getting double entries.

items.q: Can I cancel at any time?
items.a: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. With monthly billing, the subscription ends at the end of the current month; with annual billing, at the end of the current year. Your data is retained.

items.q: What happens if I use the free plan?
items.a: On the free plan, you can see the last two months of transactions and add one bank account. No CSV import, no Sankey visualization, no budgets. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time to unlock all features.
There is no native mobile app yet. However, the web interface is fully responsive and works well on smartphones. A mobile app is planned for the future.
We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) as well as SEPA direct debit. Billing is handled securely through Stripe.
